evals.prompt: 我想做一个赛博朋克风格的音乐节主视觉海报，帮我做深度设计调研。
evals.expected_output: Structured visual trend research report across multiple platforms with aesthetic clustering and prompt seeds.
expectations: Deconstructs design request across 7 core dimensions (Color, Typography, Graphics, Texture/Lighting, Composition, Emotion, Signature Techniques)
Clusters references into 3-5 distinct, differentiated design directions
Includes authentic platform references (Behance, Pinterest, Zcool, etc.)
Provides concrete, actionable execution techniques for poster designers
Derives exploratory prompt seeds with bracketed customizable placeholders

evals.prompt: Conduct deep visual research on Scandinavian minimalist furniture brand identity and catalog design on Behance and Pinterest.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive aesthetic analysis report featuring verified global references and Nordic design principles.
expectations: Focuses on global inspiration portals (Behance, Pinterest, Unsplash)
Extracts Nordic minimal design tropes (airy negative space, muted natural pigments, tactile woodgrain)
Outlines complete report structure matching references/report-template.html
Zero fabricated/hallucinated placeholder URLs for real references
Identifies cross-direction trade-offs and best-fit application scenarios
